excerpt: Routines by Databox automatically surfaces important changes in your business data and turns them into reports, inside Databox's agentic analytics platform.
content:
Routines is a feature of Databox, an analytics platform that brings performance data from across a business into one place with consistent metric definitions. Databox connects more than 130 tools, spreadsheets, databases and APIs, such as Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce and Stripe, into a governed "semantic layer" so every metric means the same thing. On top of that sit an AI Analyst you can ask questions in plain language, dashboards and reports, goals, and an MCP server so other AI tools can use the same data.

Routines automate the recurring part of analysis: they watch your data on a schedule, surface important changes and turn them into reports that explain what happened and why it matters, for example a board revenue recap every month. Databox has a free plan, with paid plans from $71 a month billed annually and a separate Agency plan.

Databox lists a Boston, Massachusetts address on its site and says it is trusted by more than 20,000 businesses. Its makers on Product Hunt include Davorin Gabrovec, founder and chief product officer. Routines launched there on 7 September 2026 and finished #4 for the day with 183 upvotes and 34 comments. Databox has 8 Product Hunt reviews averaging 4.75 out of 5 (as of 14 October 2026).

We have not tested Databox ourselves. This page brings together Databox's official site and pricing page, its Product Hunt pages and the public pricing page of a comparable tool, and says where each fact comes from.

use_cases: Getting a scheduled report when a key metric changes, without building it by hand each week
Asking an AI analyst questions about live business data
Giving AI tools governed company metrics through an MCP server
Agencies tracking performance across many clients

fit: pull numbers from many tools into recurring reports
want consistent metric definitions for both people and AI
run an agency reporting to several clients
not_fit: need only one data source and a simple dashboard: free tools may be enough
want a full data warehouse or BI modelling tool

pricing.intro: Databox has a free plan and paid plans with a 14-day trial; annual billing saves 20%. Prices are in US dollars.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 1 user, 3 data sources, 50 AI credits a month, AI Analyst, performance summaries, governed semantic layer

plans.name: Analyst
plans.detail: 1 user, 5 data sources, 150 AI credits a month, custom data integrations, MCP server, API access, hourly sync

plans.name: Team
plans.detail: For collaborative analytics and automated workflows; a larger Scale tier is $319/month billed annually

plans.name: Agency
plans.price: From $79, billed annually, plus account packs
plans.detail: For agencies managing performance across several clients

alternatives.intro: Other reporting tools for businesses and agencies. Price from the company's own pricing page on 14 October 2026.

items.what: Client reporting dashboards for marketing agencies
